notes: Phase helpers (xfer/pause/trail with 16-bit counter, sized from PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV) are driven only from interface signals. CHK-001 uses an event-driven monitor on o_cmd_ready that compares the change time with the last posedge i_clk and the last negedge i_rst_n. It counts bad changes, and the assertion checks that count at the next clock edge. It assumes the clock-edge update runs before the DUT's NBA change, which is the normal ordering. The reset-assertion case could in principle race if the DUT drives o_cmd_ready combinationally from the reset in the same step. Changes at time 0 are ignored. A handshake during Pause or Trail restarts the tracker; the CHK-004/005 assertions flag any such unexpected ready. The idle window in CHK-003 ends at the next handshake or when o_cs_n falls.
